record.title: Synthetic Monitoring — Jakarta Public Probe Degradation

updates.body:
Between 08:31 and 09:17 UTC on 6 November 2026, a network issue at the Jakarta public probe caused elevated check failures for monitors running from that location.

- DNS checks: failure rate increased from ~0.3% to ~15%
- HTTP, ping, traceroute, and browser checks: <1% failure rate
- Browser checks: some delays and retries observed
- TCP checks: not affected
- All other probe locations: not affected
